text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket has been in a slump lately. 
She said she wanted to pray for divine 
help, but when we arrived at the shrine... 
for some reason, Biwa Hayahide was there 
too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know how shrines have all these 
complicated etiquettes? I'm, like, really 
bad at using my head...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In that regard, Hayahide is super smart! 
I'm thinking of doing everything exactly 
the way she taught me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Biwa Hayahide was the one who 
told me to try praying to the gods if I 
wasn't feeling well!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In my case, praying to the gods likely 
holds no effect. However, as the saying 
goes, 'sickness stems from the mind'—one's 
mental state plays a significant role in 
poor form.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
On that point, Winning Ticket is 
exceptionally pure. Given her personality, 
maybe... Well, you get the idea, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's test it out right away. 
First, the tickets, just as I taught you—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOAAAHHH~~!! First off!! Throwing in the 
offering money!!
(*SWOOSH*...... *CLIIINGGG!!*)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?! What an incredible arm?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Next up...!! I'll ring!! That big bell!!"
(RATTLE-CLATTER-CRRRRAAAASSSSHHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, Ticket! You're being way too loud, 
even for you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No prob, no prob! If we don't give it 
everything we've got, God up in heaven 
won't even notice us!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And! The only thing left now! Is a prayer 
to the godsーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOAAAAAHHH~~!! PLEASE TAKE CAAAAAAAARE 
OF MEEEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmmm...! God, please, oh please...! 
Please let me find my energy...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "...Ticket. Hey, Ticket."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Surely you have prayed enough by now. How 
long do you intend to keep doing that?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah, that's enough already? Did my 
all-out feelings reach you!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's plenty. God must surely be 
fed u—no, satisfied by now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, really? Then I'm sure it'll give me 
tons of energy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, actually!! I feel like my body's 
already so much lighter!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, surely that's going too—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's totally cured!! Yay! God is sooo 
amaaaazing!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, we did it!! Full-power energetic 
yeeaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like you really have 
recovered. I guess it's true that illness 
is all in the mind...

Whether it was the power of prayer or 
Winning Ticket's own pure earnestness... 
either way, her slump was cleared right 
up.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmm...!! Muuuuuuungh...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gods above... please hear my wholehearted 
feelings...!! Reach theeeeem...!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Honestly. They can't hear a 
single word, can they...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...! I-I feel so hot...! 
My body's getting all wobbly and 
dizzyyy~...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Could you have gotten a fever from 
thinking too hard? You can't be 
serious..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wobble... wobble.

Perhaps because she focused too much on 
praying, Winning Ticket's slump showed no 
signs of clearing up...
